title: Love it! Works perfect in our home
text: Love it! Works perfect in our home. I was so excited to receive this and still am happy a week later! I don't normally even write reviews but some of the reviews were making me nervous and wanted to help up the stars! Must really depend on how you put it together and the thickness of your door. All my spices and ziploc bags etc have a home. I do in-home daycare so the door have been opened and shut many times within that week!
